name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Claims, line items, approvals and payroll export.

dependencies.name: receipt-agent
dependencies.description: Pre-fills a line item from an uploaded receipt.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs employees, managers and finance in.

description: The single-page app for employees, managers and finance: submitting claims, reviewing and deciding on them, and exporting approved claims to payroll. Holds no business logic of its own — every read and write goes through expense-api or receipt-agent.
